title: Nine Readers and One Comment
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：blog　|　正文 334 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 blog 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 2004 my brother started ① a blog that nine people read, and my mother said the nine were the whole of the audience. The ② blog, meaning the page and not the writing, was updated on a Sunday and was abandoned in March; a blog, he said, is the only publication that is judged by how often it stops.

Every ③ blog in that year was about the same three things, and the ④ blog with the photograph, meaning the one somebody actually commented on and not either of those, was the only one he ever mentioned. A blog, my grandmother said, is nine parts opinion and one part somebody willing to answer; my brother said the opinion is the part they come for.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ blog was the whole of the notebook, meaning the record and not the page. The ⑥ blog, meaning the habit of writing things down and not any of that, is the only thing in a house that everybody can read and nobody is meant to; a blog, he said, is either a page on a screen or the only word that means both a website and a diary. She said the diary came first.

By 2011 the ⑦ blog had become a line in a CV, and the line had become an argument about whether it counted as writing. The ⑧ blog of the whole thing, my brother wrote in April, was nine readers and eleven years of Sundays; a blog, he said, is either the page with the photograph or the reason you learned to finish things. She said the finishing was the part that never happened.

The ⑨ blog I remember is the one with the photograph, which was deleted in 2013 and is still being quoted. A ⑩ blog, my mother said in 2015, is the only writing that improves by being abandoned; every blog, she said, is a diary that has agreed to look like a page. He said the diary was always the point.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 博客；网络日志
B. n. 博客（指那个页面，与写的东西相对）
C. 固定搭配：start a blog 开一个博客
D. n. 博客（指那一年每一个）
E. n. 博客（指带照片那一个）
F. n. 记录；日志（指笔记本里那些记载）
G. n. 记录（抽象：把事情写下来这种习惯）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a blog that nine people read
The blog, meaning the page and not the writing
blog was the whole of the notebook
The blog, meaning the habit of writing things down
the blog had become a line in a CV
The blog of the whole thing
A blog, my mother said in 2015

answers.why: start a blog 意为“开一个博客”，2004 年哥哥开了一个只有九个人看的博客。
blog 意为“博客”，指那个页面而不是写的东西，它星期天更新，三月被弃更。
blog 指那一年每一个博客，那一年每一个都在说同样的三件事。
blog 指带照片那一个（唯一有人真的留言的那一个），是唯一他提起过的。
blog 意为“记录、日志”，指笔记本里那些记载，父亲说 blog 就是那本笔记本的全部。
blog 为抽象用法，指把事情写下来这种习惯，是屋里人人都读得、却本不该读的东西。
blog 意为“博客”，到 2011 年这个 blog 成了简历里的一行。
blog 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，哥哥四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九个读者和十一年的星期天。
blog 意为“博客”，我记得的是带照片那一个，2013 年被删掉，至今仍被人引用。
blog 为抽象总称，母亲说博客是唯一会因为被弃更而变好的文字。
